newsitem.title: NORWAY: Hydro to upgrade carbon plant.
newsitem.headline: Hydro to upgrade carbon plant.

text.p: Norwegian industrial group Norsk Hydro ASA on Monday announced a NOK 500 million modernisation programme of its carbon facilities at Aardal in western Norway.
Baked anode capacity at Aardal will thus increase to 159,000 tonnes from 110,000 tonnes per year, a statement said.
The plant produces anodes for, among others, the metal plant in Aardal. Most of the upgrading will be made in 1998 and the programme be completed the following spring.
